tools.name: export_csv
tools.description: Export the current data view (including any filters and sorting) to a CSV file for download.

tools.name: fetch_dataset
tools.description: Fetch a JSON-stat dataset from a URL. Supports both GET and POST requests. For POST requests, provide a JSON payload.

url.description: The URL of the JSON-stat dataset endpoint to fetch

payload.description: Optional JSON payload for POST requests

tools.name: filter_dimension
tools.description: Filter a dimension to show only specific categories. Provide an array of category labels to include. Empty array shows all categories.

dimensionId.description: The ID of the dimension to filter

categories.description: Array of category labels to include. Empty array means show all categories.

tools.name: get_data_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of the current data view including row counts, view mode, active filters, and sort settings.

tools.name: get_dimensions
tools.description: Get a list of all dimensions in the current dataset with their properties, available categories, and current filter settings.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Get comprehensive metadata about the currently loaded dataset including label, source, dimensions, and observation count.

tools.name: get_preset_endpoints
tools.description: Get a list of available preset JSON-stat endpoints that can be quickly loaded.

tools.name: search_data
tools.description: Search for text across all cells in the current data view. Only available in flat view mode.

query.description: The search query to find in the data. Empty string clears the search.

tools.name: select_dataset
tools.description: Select a specific dataset from a loaded bundle or collection. Use this after loading a bundle with fetch_dataset.

datasetIndex.description: The index of the dataset to select (0-based)

tools.name: set_dimension_role
tools.description: Set the role of a dimension for data visualization. In flat mode, use 'row'. In pivot mode, use 'row' or 'column'.

dimensionId.description: The ID of the dimension to set the role for

role.description: The role to set: 'row' to show as row, 'column' to show as column (pivot only)

tools.name: set_view_mode
tools.description: Switch between flat (value list) and pivot (cross-tabulation) view modes. Flat mode shows all dimensions as rows, pivot mode allows cross-tabulation.

mode.description: The view mode to set: 'flat' for value list, 'pivot' for cross-tabulation

tools.name: sort_data
tools.description: Sort the data by a specific column in ascending or descending order.

columnIndex.description: The index of the column to sort by (0-based)

direction.description: Sort direction: 'asc' or 'ascending' for ascending, 'desc' or 'descending' for descending
